x-e-m2-05.title: Nyora patsva chirevo chokuti kuenda kuraibhurari kazhinji kunokwidza zvibodzwa
x-e-m2-05.goal: Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichiratidzwa, tongazve kuti unogona kuvimba zvakadini nechirevo, uye unyore patsva mutsara wokupedzisira.
x-e-m2-05.material: Munyori webhurogu anoda kunyora kuti: 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' Ngatitarisei mutsara uyu nedata.
x-e-m2-05.prereq.0: Verenga mitsara yeChirungu iri nyore (average, score, library visits)
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa chikamu chimwe panguva imwe. Pachinhanho chega chega, sarudza kutonga kunokodzera zvikuru uchishandisa zvinozikanwa kusvikira zvino chete.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.hint.0: Pachinhanho chega chega, tarisa kana ruzivo rutsva rwuchitsigira kutonga kwapamberi kana kuzunguza.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti 'kuchinja pamwe chete' kunosiyana sei ne 'kuchinja nokuda kwa'.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Zvakadini nokunyora kuti 'Library visits make scores go up' kubva padata iri oga?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Data inoratidza chete kuti zvinhu zviviri zvinofamba pamwe chete. Hatisati tazvikwanisa kuziva kana raibhurari iri chikonzero.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kuchinja pamwe chete nokuva chikonzero zvakasiyana.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Kushanyira raibhurari nezvibodzwa zvinofamba pamwe chete, asi hatisati taziva kuti sei.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kutonga uku kunosiyanisa hukama hwokufamba pamwe chete nechikonzero.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Data inoratidza kuti pane hukama. Kutaura kuti hapana kupesana nedata.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kutonga kwako kuchachinja sei kana ruzivo urwu rwuchiwedzerwa?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana vadzidzi vanoenda kazhinji vanewo dzimwe tsika, zvinova zvakaoma kupatsanura kana raibhurari kana tsika idzodzo dziri chikonzero chomusiyano wezvibodzwa.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Zvimwe zvikonzero, senge basa romumba nokurara, zvinogona kutsanangura zvose zvibodzwa nokushanyira.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunofunga nomukana wedzimwe tsananguro.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Zvakajeka zvikuru kuti raibhurari ndicho chikonzero.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ruzivo rutsva panzvimbo pezvo runowedzera dzimwe tsananguro.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ruzivo rutsva harurambi data rokutanga. Runongowedzera kududzira.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Uchaongorora sei mutsara wepakutanga nemhedzisiro yeuedzo uyu?
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Boka rakashanyira rakakwira nehuwandu hwakafanana neboka risina kushanyira. Mutsara wepakutanga hautsigirwi neuedzo uyu. Unogona kurangaririwo kuti nguva pfupi imuganho.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Zvasimbiswa kuti kushanyira raibhurari kunokwidza zvibodzwa zvakawanda.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Shanduko yemapoka maviri yakafanana, 1 poinzi. Boka rakashanyira harina kukwira zvakawanda.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Muuedzo uyu, kushanyira hakuna kukwidza zvibodzwa zvakawanda.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Kutonga uku kunobva pakuenzanisa shanduko yemapoka maviri.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Vhiki ina shoma, saka tinofanira kungwarira, asi hazvitsigire mutsara wepakutanga.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kutonga uku kunobvuma miganho yemhedzisiro asi kunoona kuti haiite chigadziko chechirevo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga unogona kungotaura kuti 'zvinofamba pamwe chete'. Neruzivo rwechipiri, dzimwe tsananguro dzakaonekwa, uye neuedzo hwechitatu, mutsara wepakutanga wakava husina simba. Funga kuti ruzivo rupi rwakachinja kutonga kwako.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mutsara mumwe kana maviri weChirungu unoenderana nedata zvakanaka kupfuura 'Library visits make students' scores go up.' uye unogona kushandiswa nomunyori webhurogu panzvimbo yawo.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.0: Paradzanisa zvaunogona kutaura nechokwadi nezvausati waziva kubva pazvikamu zvitatu zvedata.
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.hint.1: Unogona kushandisa mashoko anoderedza simba rechirevo (may, does not prove, nezvimwe).
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mutsara wako unoenderana nezvikamu zvose zvitatu zvedata here?
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Chirevo chisina simba kupfuura mutsara wepakutanga here?
x-e-m2-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakachengeta here chikamu chechokwadi (kufamba pamwe chete)?

x-e-m2-01.s.s2.r.b: Kunyange nhamba mbiri dzichienderana, kana dzisiri makosha akaverengwa chaizvo, ruzivo rusina kururama runoramba.

x-e-m2-03.title: Tsvaga ndandanda inokodzera mamiriro mu email yemusangano weclub
x-e-m2-03.goal: Verenga mamiriro ose emu email, gadzira ndandanda dzakasiyana dzinogutsa, uye utsanangure mamiriro awakatarisa.
x-e-m2-03.material:
Iyi email yakabva kuna Hana, mutungamiri wereading club, kuenda kumember, Minho. Nyora mazuva senhamba: Mon=1, Tue=2, Wed=3, Thu=4, Fri=5.

Hi Minho,
Let's plan our reading club meeting for next week.
1) We meet on a weekday, Monday to Friday, but not on Wednesday (I have a dentist visit) and not on Friday (the library closes early).
2) School ends at 3 p.m., so we can start at 3 p.m. at the earliest. The room can be used until 6 p.m.
3) The meeting takes two hours, and it always starts on the hour.
Please send me the days and start times that work.
Thanks, Hana

x-e-m2-03.s.s0.r.b: Wakaverenga nguva iyo room inogona kushandiswa kusvika pamwe chete nehurefu hwemusangano.
x-e-m2-03.s.s0.r.c: Uyu mutsara wechikumbiro, saka haugumiri nguva.
x-e-m2-03.s.s0.explain: Nguva yekupera (6 o'clock) nehurefu hwemusangano (two hours) zvinogadzira muganhu wekupedzisira wenguva yekutanga. Mamiriro ezuva nemutsara wechikumbiro hazvigadziri muganhu wenguva.
